title: Smooth relative differentials are finite locally free without constant rank
statement: Let f:X\to S be a smooth morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Its sheaf of relative differentials [def-sc-relative-differential-sheaf] is finite locally free [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. The finite rank may vary with the point.

source.place: Tag 02G1, proof on standard smooth affine charts, with rank allowed to vary.

proof.text: Choose standard smooth affine charts at each point via Mathlib Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth. The chosen submersive presentation has a finite dimension d and gives a basis of the Kahler module; apply the library nonempty_linearEquiv_kaehlerDifferential.

Use relativeDifferentialsRestrictIso, relativeDifferentialsCongr, relativeDifferentialsCompIso and relativeDifferentialsSpecIso to identify each pullback with the differential module sheaf on the affine chart. The section module is finite free; the affine rank criterion gives IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d on this chart.
Forget the locally constant rank on each chart and apply Modules.isFiniteLocallyFree_of_isOpenImmersion to this open cover.
